ask: Does this fix let you add languages without touching the test?
problem: A nightly test said the Language sheet should have 16 rows but found 17. Each new language would break it again.
found: Tagalog was added as a new app language. The test kept its own typed list and count, so it went stale.
changed: The test now reads the app's own list of languages. It counts rows from that list and checks every row's names. The app is unchanged.
why: One list now decides both the sheet and the test, so new languages need no test edit. I could not run the browser test here; the nightly run will show it. The tutorial video narration still says fifteen languages; I left it alone.
touches: Only one test file. No app change.
